title: Intrinsic proper/open mates and pasting for varying coefficient systems
statement:
Let $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be any inverse sequence of commutative rings, and put $B_{n,T}=(C_n)_T$ on a fixed small skeleton of the pro-etale site of every scheme $T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\mathscr S_T$ be the category of strict semilinear module systems: an object consists of $B_{n,T}$-module sheaves $M_n$ and $B_{n+1,T}$-linear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{n+1,n}M_n$; morphisms commute with transitions. Use $D(\mathscr S_T)$ and its simultaneous section models [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. For a scheme map $v$, let $P_v$ be exact termwise inverse image and $S_v$ total derived direct image, with $P_v\dashv S_v$, unit $\eta_v$ and counit $\varepsilon_v$. For an open immersion $a$, let $J_a\dashv P_a$ be exact termwise extension by zero, with open unit the identity on sections over the open [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Direct-image compositors are mates of inverse-image compositors [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting].

Let $Q$ be a commutative square of schemes with top arrow $k:U\hookrightarrow V$, bottom arrow $i:W\hookrightarrow Z$ quasi-compact open, vertical arrows $r:U\to W$, $p:V\to Z$ proper, and $pk=ir$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Set $V_W=V\times_ZW$ with projections $b:V_W\to V$, $q:V_W\to W$, and $s=(k,r):U\to V_W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $s$ is clopen. Let $\pi_s:M\to J_sP_sM$ be projection to the component $s(U)$, identity there and zero on its complementary open. Put
$$\alpha_Q:P_pJ_i\xrightarrow{\beta_{i,p}}J_bP_q\xrightarrow{J_b\pi_sP_q}J_bJ_sP_sP_q\cong J_kP_r,$$
where $\beta$ is the open-unit-normalized map of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], and define its proper mate
$$\Gamma_Q=(S_pJ_k\varepsilon_r)\circ(S_p\alpha_QS_r)\circ(\eta_pJ_iS_r):J_iS_r\to S_pJ_k.$$
There is a canonical isomorphism
$$\lambda_Q:P_iS_pJ_k\cong S_qP_bJ_k\cong S_qJ_s\cong S_qS_s\cong S_r.$$
The first isomorphism is right-adjoint conjugation of the cartesian open comparison $P_pJ_i\cong J_bP_q$; the middle identification $J_s=S_s$ is the clopen section formula. The map $\Gamma_Q$ is the $J_i\dashv P_i$ adjunct of $\lambda_Q^{-1}$, and $\lambda_Q\circ P_i\Gamma_Q=1$ under the open unit.

For vertical pasting $Q_1$ above $Q_2$ with vertical maps $r_1,r_2$ on the left and $p_1,p_2$ on the right, and for horizontal pasting $Q_1$ left of $Q_2$ with top opens $k,l$, bottom opens $i,j$ and verticals $r,p,q$, respectively,
$$\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(S_{p_2}\Gamma_{Q_1})\circ(\Gamma_{Q_2}S_{r_1}),\qquad
\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(\Gamma_{Q_2}J_k)\circ(J_j\Gamma_{Q_1}).$$
For base change $h:Z_1\to Z$, write $a:V_1\to V$, $c:W_1\to W$, $d:U_1\to U$ for the projections, and $Q_1$ for the induced square. Let $E_p:P_hS_p\to S_{p_1}P_a$ and $E_r:P_cS_r\to S_{r_1}P_d$ be the canonical pullback-square mates. Then
$$(S_{p_1}\beta_{k,a})\circ(E_pJ_k)\circ(P_h\Gamma_Q)
=(\Gamma_{Q_1}P_d)\circ(J_{i_1}E_r)\circ(\beta_{i,h}S_r).$$
All equations use the canonical compositors, hold in the semilinear derived categories before evaluation, and are independent of parenthesization. Identity verticals or identity horizontals give identity transformations. They apply also to noncartesian refinement squares, where $r=1$ and $s$ is the clopen section.

If a commutative ring $B$ has compatible maps $B\to C_n$, termwise restriction to constant-$B$ module towers identifies $\Gamma_Q$ with the normalized constant-tower mate of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus], via the canonical scalar-restriction direct-image and pullback comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Evaluation gives the same mate over $C_n$. When $C_n$ is finite and the evaluated input has a bounded-below etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], it is the specified finite proper/open comparison. No faithfulness of derived evaluation or scalar restriction on morphisms is asserted.

proof.text: Identify the actual intrinsic system constructions with the varying-ring constructions by [lem-sf-intrinsic-varying-ring-mate-normalization]. Equality of the coefficient maps identifies the chosen ordinary adjunctions; their exact localizations identify beta, the clopen projector, the open compositor and alpha. The proper-adjunction mate is therefore the varying-ring gamma, before evaluation.

Let $m:P_sP_q\cong P_r$ and $d:J_bJ_s\cong J_k$ be the compositors and $f=J_s(\varepsilon_r\circ m_{S_r})\circ\pi_sP_qS_r$. Expanding $\alpha_Q$ and cancelling $\beta^{-1}$, the hypothesis $J_k(\varepsilon_r)\circ\alpha_QS_r\circ\beta^{-1}S_r=d\circ J_b(f)$ of [lem-sf-adjunct-conjugate-open-factor] is naturality of $d$. That lemma gives $S_q(z)\circ cJ_k\circ\operatorname{adj}_{J_i\dashv P_i}(\Gamma_Q)=S_q(f)\circ\eta_q$. By the intrinsic core construction of pi and the proved openToS_isIso, $t_s:J_s\cong S_s$ and $(t_sP_s)\pi_s=\eta_s$; naturality of $t_s$ turns $S_q(t_sf)\eta_q$ into $S_qS_s(\varepsilon_rm)\circ S_q\eta_sP_qS_r\circ\eta_q$, the composite-adjunction unit then counit, inverse to $S_qS_s\cong S_r$ by the triangle identities. As $\lambda_Q$ is that compositor after $S_q(t_s)$, $S_q(z)$, $cJ_k$, the adjunct is $\lambda_Q^{-1}$; since it equals $P_i\Gamma_Q$ after the invertible open unit [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], $\lambda_QP_i\Gamma_Q=1$.

The intrinsic-varying-ring normalization identifies gamma, the proper compositors, the identity comparisons and the open compositors. Transport the two proved pasting laws and the two proved identity laws of [lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting] along these equalities. The transport is on whole system derived categories and preserves every supplied square equality.

Apply [lem-sf-semilinear-alpha-pullback] to the varying-ring inverse-image cube. Cancel its four invertible comparison maps to put the cube into the inverse-face convention of [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-mate-cube], and take the four proper-adjunction mates. The normalized beta and inverse-image square compositors identify the resulting varying-ring exchanges with the specified intrinsic exchanges. Transport the complete component equation to the intrinsic operations.

Apply [lem-sf-intrinsic-scalar-alpha-compatibility] to the actual rho, rhoP and rhoJ from [def-sf-semilinear-scalar-normalization-data]. The direct-image comparison rhoR is by definition the mate of rhoP inverse and is already invertible. Mathlib unit_mateEquiv and mateEquiv_counit give both adjunction-evaluation equations for these specified maps. Apply evaluation_mate of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] to the alpha compatibility square, using the two proper adjunctions. Unfold gamma and StrictTower.gamma only. The result is exactly gamma_scalarRestriction, with every canonical comparison retained.

Apply [lem-sf-intrinsic-evaluation-alpha-compatibility] to the actual E, evalP and evalJ of [def-sf-semilinear-evaluation-normalization-data]. The specified evalR is the mate of evalP inverse and is already invertible. The unit and counit mate equations supply an AdjunctionEvaluation record at each proper edge. Apply evaluation_mate of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] and unfold the two gamma definitions, obtaining gamma_evaluation on entire derived systems. The existing gamma_finite proof then transports this equation through its source/target isomorphisms and uses [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus] for the finite etale-origin normalization.

The already proved compositor_associativity in [lem-sf-intrinsic-semilinear-compositor-coherence] derives ordinary push coherence from its section formula, conjugates it to pull coherence, localizes it, and conjugates once more for direct images and open extensions. The unchanged original proof lives in its own support module for compile time. Every equality remains on systems before evaluation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F7B, 0F7C, 0F7D and 0F7F. Retain the proved pasting, identity, clopen and finite clauses. Reduce the two coefficient-mate clauses to the strictly pre-mate exact alpha comparisons, and complete their assembly using the proved evaluation_mate with explicit unit/counit normalization. Two upper holes closed and two exact inverse-image compatibility statements split off; this is a decomposition, not a net hole reduction.
